content: Current npm package docs for Napplet SDK 0.25.0 say strict iframe CSP blocks direct fetch and external image URLs; bytes must be fetched through the shell resource domain, which supports hash-verified blossom addresses. Shell domains own signing, relay routing, and policy. The Vite plugin supports single-file opaque-origin artifacts and signed hashed manifests. Current conformance tooling boots real Chromium under sandbox allow-scripts and checks manifest hashes, injected domains, envelope validation, graceful degradation, and forbidden globals. No generic Lightning payment domain is documented in the SDK surface.
